title: My Stepdaughter Stole My $115K Inheritance. So I Made Her Wind Yarn With Her Fraud Docket.
description: After my stepdaughter stole my entire $115K widow's inheritance and vanished, I hired a forensic accountant to trace the blockchain. The court ordered her to hand-wind yarn in my shop, Purl of Perjury, wearing an apron that says 'Tangled in Crypto Lies' while every label prints the fraud docket. #RevengeStory #CryptoScam #YarnShopJustice
thumb_text: SHE STOLE MY $115K AND VANISHED. NOW SHE HAND-WINDS SKEINS.
pinned_comment: If your stepdaughter drained your $115,000 widow's inheritance and you traced it to a crypto wallet, would you have done what I did? Tell me your story in the comments.
